# Setup type API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

A shared classification of experimental preparations, such as head-fixed or freely moving.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/taxonomies/setuptype/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/taxonomies/setuptype/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `setup_type` (detail, create, update), `setup_types` (list)
- **Permissions:** see the [permissions page](/datamodel/permissions/)
- **Uniqueness:** `name` unique across BrainSTEM
- **Deleting:** refused (400) while [`behavioralassay`](/api/personal_attributes/behavioralassay/), [`setup`](/api/personal_attributes/setup/) records point to it

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `name` | string **[required]**; max 200 characters |
| `description` | string; max 2000 characters |
| `category` | one of `I`, `E`, `A`, `HA`, `RA`, `FA`, `U` **[required]** |
| `biological_preparation` | string **[read-only]** |
| `physiological_state` | string **[read-only]** |
| `constraint_level` | string **[read-only]** |
| `comments` | string |
| `user` | [`user`](/api/users/user/) id **[read-only]** |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/taxonomies/setuptype/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('setuptype', load_all=True)
records = resp['setup_types']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('setuptype', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.setup_types;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "setup_types": [
        {
            "id": "<id>",
            "name": "Setup type 1",
            "description": "",
            "category": "I",
            "biological_preparation": "",
            "physiological_state": "",
            "constraint_level": "",
            "comments": "",
            "user": "<user-id>"
        }
    ],
    "meta": {
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 100,
        "total_results": 1,
        "total_pages": 1
    }
}
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/taxonomies/setuptype/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('setuptype', data={"name": "Setup type 1", "category": "I"})
record = resp.json()['setup_type']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('name', 'Setup type 1', 'category', 'I'), 'setuptype');
record = created.setup_type;
```

## Detail
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/taxonomies/setuptype/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('setuptype', id='<id>')
record = resp.json()['setup_type']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
out = client.load('setuptype', 'id', '<id>');
record = out.setup_type;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "setup_type": {
        "id": "<id>",
        "name": "Setup type 1",
        "description": "",
        "category": "I",
        "biological_preparation": "",
        "physiological_state": "",
        "constraint_level": "",
        "comments": "",
        "user": "<user-id>"
    }
}
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/taxonomies/setuptype/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('setuptype', id='<id>', data={"name": "Setup type 1 (renamed)"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'name', 'Setup type 1 (renamed)'), 'setuptype', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/taxonomies/setuptype/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('setuptype', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'setuptype');
```

## Data model

The fields are described for the web forms on the [Setup type data model page](/datamodel/taxonomies/setuptype/).

## Usage notes

- `category` codes: `I` In Vitro, `E` Ex Vivo, `A` Anesthetized In Vivo, `HA` Head-Fixed Awake, `RA` Restrained Awake, `FA` Freely Moving Awake, `U` Unknown. The [Setup types data model page](/datamodel/taxonomies/setuptype/) explains each category.
